verdict.rationale: PostHog's hosted MCP server exposes a Dashboards tool category (18 tools) alongside insight, SQL and analytics tools. Its own agents explicitly create dashboards: PostHog AI "creates dashboards" and the agentic wizard "Generates insights and dashboards in the PostHog app". Together these support an agent building a key-metrics dashboard end-to-end. missing for 10: explicitly named dashboard/insight create-and-update MCP or REST endpoints documenting the end-to-end flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of an external agent assembling a dashboard via MCP.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: The PostHog MCP server exposes function-calling MCP tools across every PostHog product
PostHog AI creates dashboards, surveys, alerts, and feature flags
Generates insights and dashboards in the PostHog app
PostHog's MCP server to query insights, dashboards, Feature Flags, errors, and other project data
